name: Attendance Incident Prefill
script:
# API: attendance_incident_prefill
user = frappe.session.user
roles = [row.role for row in frappe.get_doc("User", user).roles] if user != "Administrator" else ["System Manager"]
if not any(role in ("System Manager", "HR Manager", "HR User") for role in roles):
    frappe.throw("Only HR can read attendance incidents.", frappe.PermissionError)
employee = frappe.form_dict.get("employee")
incident_date = frappe.form_dict.get("incident_date")
selected_shift = frappe.form_dict.get("shift_type")
if not employee or not incident_date:
    frappe.throw("Employee and incident date are required.")
day = frappe.utils.getdate(incident_date)
if day > frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate()):
    frappe.throw("The incident date cannot be in the future.")
emp = frappe.get_doc("Employee", employee)
emp.check_permission("read")
result = {
    "employee": employee, "incident_date": str(day), "employee_name": emp.employee_name,
    "designation": emp.designation, "department": emp.department, "company": emp.company,
    "manager": emp.reports_to, "job_description": emp.custom_fiche_de_poste, "shift_type": None, "scheduled_start": None, "scheduled_end": None,
    "actual_arrival": None, "actual_departure": None, "late_period": "",
    "late_minutes": 0, "early_minutes": 0, "absence_minutes": 0,
    "source_attendance": None,
    "source_leave": None, "source_checkins": "", "suggested_incident_type": None,
    "prefilled_at": str(frappe.utils.now_datetime()),
}
notes = []
assignments = frappe.get_all("Shift Assignment",
    filters={"employee": employee, "start_date": ["<=", day], "docstatus": 1, "status": "Active"},
    fields=["shift_type", "end_date"], order_by="start_date desc, creation desc")
shifts = []
for row in assignments:
    if (not row.end_date or frappe.utils.getdate(row.end_date) >= day) and row.shift_type not in shifts:
        shifts.append(row.shift_type)
if not shifts and emp.default_shift:
    shifts = [emp.default_shift]
if selected_shift and selected_shift not in shifts:
    frappe.throw("The selected shift is not assigned to this employee on this date.")
if len(shifts) > 1 and not selected_shift:
    frappe.throw("Several shifts are assigned. Select the shift before prefilling.")
shift_name = selected_shift or (shifts[0] if shifts else None)
shift = frappe.get_doc("Shift Type", shift_name) if shift_name else None
start = frappe.utils.get_datetime(str(day) + " 00:00:00")
end = frappe.utils.add_to_date(start, days=1)
scheduled_start = None
if shift:
    result["shift_type"] = shift.name
    scheduled_start = frappe.utils.get_datetime(str(day) + " " + str(shift.start_time))
    scheduled_end = frappe.utils.get_datetime(str(day) + " " + str(shift.end_time))
    if scheduled_end <= scheduled_start:
        scheduled_end = frappe.utils.add_to_date(scheduled_end, days=1)
    result["scheduled_start"] = str(scheduled_start)
    result["scheduled_end"] = str(scheduled_end)
    late_tolerance = frappe.utils.flt(shift.late_entry_grace_period)
    early_tolerance = frappe.utils.flt(shift.early_exit_grace_period)
    before = max(120, frappe.utils.flt(shift.begin_check_in_before_shift_start_time))
    after = max(120, frappe.utils.flt(shift.allow_check_out_after_shift_end_time))
    start = frappe.utils.add_to_date(scheduled_start, minutes=-before)
    end = frappe.utils.add_to_date(scheduled_end, minutes=after)
else:
    notes.append("No assigned shift was found. Verify expected times manually.")
logs = frappe.get_all("Employee Checkin",
    filters={"employee": employee, "time": ["between", [start, end]], "docstatus": ["!=", 2]},
    fields=["name", "time", "log_type", "shift", "shift_start"], order_by="time asc, creation asc")
if shift:
    logs = [log for log in logs if not log.shift or (log.shift == shift.name and
        (not log.shift_start or frappe.utils.get_datetime(log.shift_start) == scheduled_start))]
alternating = bool(shift and shift.determine_check_in_and_check_out == "Alternating entries as IN and OUT during the same shift")
ins = logs[::2] if alternating else [log for log in logs if log.log_type == "IN"]
outs = logs[1::2] if alternating else [log for log in logs if log.log_type == "OUT"]
first = ins[0] if ins else None
last = outs[-1] if outs else None
result["actual_arrival"] = (str(first.time)[:16] + ":00") if first else None
result["actual_departure"] = (str(last.time)[:16] + ":00") if last else None
result["source_checkins"] = "\n".join(log.name for log in logs)
attendance_filters = {"employee": employee, "attendance_date": day, "docstatus": 1}
if shift_name:
    attendance_filters["shift"] = shift_name
attendances = frappe.get_all("Attendance", filters=attendance_filters,
    fields=["name", "in_time", "out_time"], limit=2)
if len(attendances) == 1:
    attendance = attendances[0]
    result["source_attendance"] = attendance.name
    if not logs and (attendance.in_time or attendance.out_time):
        result["actual_arrival"] = (str(attendance.in_time)[:16] + ":00") if attendance.in_time else None
        result["actual_departure"] = (str(attendance.out_time)[:16] + ":00") if attendance.out_time else None
        notes.append("Times came from Attendance; verify the original check-ins.")
leaves = frappe.get_all("Leave Application",
    filters={"employee": employee, "from_date": ["<=", day], "to_date": [">=", day],
        "docstatus": 1, "status": "Approved"}, fields=["name", "half_day"], limit=2)
if leaves:
    result["source_leave"] = leaves[0].name
    notes.append("Approved leave exists; HR must confirm the absence classification.")
    if not result["actual_arrival"] and not result["actual_departure"] and not leaves[0].half_day:
        result["suggested_incident_type"] = "Justified Absence"
holiday_list = (shift.holiday_list if shift else None) or emp.holiday_list
if not holiday_list and emp.company:
    holiday_list = frappe.db.get_value("Company", emp.company, "default_holiday_list")
if holiday_list and frappe.db.exists("Holiday", {"parent": holiday_list, "holiday_date": day}):
    notes.append("This is a holiday or rest day. Verify whether attendance was expected.")
    result["suggested_incident_type"] = None
if not logs:
    notes.append("No check-ins were found. This does not establish unjustified absence.")
elif not first or not last:
    notes.append("Check-ins are incomplete. Verify a missing entry or exit.")
latest = frappe.db.get_value("Employee Checkin", {"docstatus": ["!=", 2]}, "time", order_by="time desc")
if latest and frappe.utils.get_datetime(latest).date() < day:
    notes.append("The latest check-in is dated " + str(frappe.utils.getdate(latest)) + ". Check device synchronization.")
if shift and frappe.utils.now_datetime() < end:
    notes.append("The shift or synchronization window is unfinished.")
if result["actual_arrival"] and result["scheduled_start"]:
    result["late_minutes"] = round(max(0, frappe.utils.time_diff_in_seconds(result["actual_arrival"], result["scheduled_start"]) / 60), 2)
    if result["late_minutes"] > 0:
        a = frappe.utils.get_datetime(result["scheduled_start"])
        b = frappe.utils.get_datetime(result["actual_arrival"])
        result["late_period"] = (str(a)[11:16] if a.date() == b.date() else str(a)[8:10] + "/" + str(a)[5:7] + " " + str(a)[11:16]) + " – " + (str(b)[11:16] if a.date() == b.date() else str(b)[8:10] + "/" + str(b)[5:7] + " " + str(b)[11:16])
if result["actual_departure"] and result["scheduled_end"]:
    result["early_minutes"] = round(max(0, frappe.utils.time_diff_in_seconds(result["scheduled_end"], result["actual_departure"]) / 60), 2)
if shift and first and last and frappe.utils.now_datetime() >= end:
    if shift.enable_late_entry_marking and result["late_minutes"] > late_tolerance:
        result["suggested_incident_type"] = "Late Arrival"
    elif shift.enable_early_exit_marking and result["early_minutes"] > early_tolerance:
        result["suggested_incident_type"] = "Early Departure"
if result["suggested_incident_type"] == "Justified Absence" and result["scheduled_start"] and result["scheduled_end"]:
    result["absence_minutes"] = round(frappe.utils.time_diff_in_seconds(result["scheduled_end"], result["scheduled_start"]) / 60, 2)
result["data_notes"] = "\n".join(notes)
result["source_snapshot"] = json.dumps({key: result.get(key) for key in
    ("employee", "incident_date", "shift_type", "scheduled_start", "scheduled_end",
     "actual_arrival", "actual_departure", "source_attendance", "source_checkins", "prefilled_at")}, default=str)
frappe.flags.result = result
